/* SmsCousMapper.selectEcmUserList : Ecm User List */ SELECT usr.USE_YN ,usr.USER_TYPE ,usr.USER_ID ,usr.USER_LOGIN_ID ,usr.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,usr.USER_NAME ,usr.CUSTOMER_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = usr.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,usr.REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime FROM TB_SMS_USER usr LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_USER_OPTION opt ON usr.ENT_CODE = opt.ENT_CODE AND usr.USER_ID = opt.USER_ID WHERE usr.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND opt.USER_CLASS = 'ECM-USER'
AND usr.CUSTOMER_CODE = #{srchCustomerCode}

/*SmsCousMapper.selectEcmCustomTreeList : 거래처 하위 리스트 조회*/ WITH tree_query AS ( SELECT cus.CUSTOMER_CODE AS id , cus.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE AS upper , cus.CUSTOMER_CODE + '(' + cus.CUSTOMER_NAME + ')' AS text , cus.CUSTOMER_NAME AS cusName , cus.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS type , cus.REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus WHERE cus.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND cus.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE = #{srchParentId} UNION ALL SELECT B.CUSTOMER_CODE AS id , B.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE AS upper , B.CUSTOMER_CODE + '(' + B.CUSTOMER_NAME + ')' AS text , B.CUSTOMER_NAME AS cusName , B.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS type , B.REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER B, tree_query C WHERE B.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE = C.id )
SELECT A.* FROM tree_query A ORDER BY registerDateTime DESC

/* SmsCousMapper.selectEcmUserDetail : Ecm User Detail */ SELECT usr.USER_ID AS userId ,usr.USER_LOGIN_ID AS userLoginId ,CASE WHEN usr.USER_LOGIN_PW IS NOT NULL AND USER_LOGIN_PW != '' THEN 'userLoginPw' ELSE '' END AS userLoginPw ,usr.USER_TYPE AS userType ,usr.USER_NAME AS userName ,usr.USER_TEL AS userTel ,usr.USER_CELLPHONE AS userCellphone ,usr.USER_EMAIL AS userEmail ,usr.USE_YN AS useYn ,usr.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AS entBusinessCode ,usr.CUSTOMER_CODE AS customerCode ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = usr.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS customerName ,usr.REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime ,usr.UPDATE_DATE_TIME AS updateDateTime ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = usr.register_user_id) AS registerUserName ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = usr.update_user_id) AS updateUserName ,usr.USER_ADDRESS AS userAddress ,usr.USER_ADDRESS_A AS userAddressA ,usr.USER_ADDRESS_B AS userAddressB ,usr.LB_CFT_TYPE AS lbCftType ,usr.CURRENCY_CODE AS currencyCode ,usr.EXCEL_TYPE AS excelType ,usr.CB_CODE AS cbCode ,usr.TR_CODE AS trCode ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = usr.CB_CODE) AS cbName ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = usr.TR_CODE) AS trName ,opt.USER_CLASS AS userClass ,opt.SEARCH_OPTION_HIDE_YN AS searchOptionHideYn ,opt.SEARCH_START_TERM AS searchStartTerm ,opt.SEARCH_END_TERM AS searchEndTerm ,opt.SEARCH_ALL_USER_YN AS searchAllUserYn ,opt.SEARCH_DEFAULT_USER_YN AS searchDefaultUserYn ,opt.PW_UPDATE_DAYS AS pwUpdateDays ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,opt.PW_UPDATE_DATE, CAST(#{dateFormat} AS INT)) AS pwUpdateDate ,opt.PW_ERROR_COUNT AS pwErrorCount ,opt.PW_UPDATE_ALERT_DAYS AS pwUpdateAlertDays ,opt.SPREAD_YN AS spreadYn ,opt.VALID_USE_DAYS AS validUseDays ,opt.DEFAULT_SOLUTION_CODE ,opt.DEFAULT_BOUND ,opt.DEFAULT_BOUND_TYPE FROM TB_SMS_USER usr LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_USER_OPTION opt ON usr.ENT_CODE = opt.ENT_CODE AND usr.USER_ID = opt.USER_ID WHERE usr.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND usr.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SmsCousMapper.selectEcmCustomerBank : ECM Customer Bank Detail */ SELECT TOP 1 USE_YN ,PAYMENT_ACCOUNTS_YN ,BOUND ,BOUND_TYPE ,BANK_CODE ,BANK_OFFICE_NAME ,CURRENCY_CODE ,BANK_ACCOUNT_NO ,BANK_DEPOSITOR ,REMARKS ,BANK_ASSIGN_DATE ,PRINT_YN ,DISPLAY_INDEX ,BANK_ACCOUNTS_CODE ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = bnk.BANK_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'BANK' AND ENT_CODE = bnk.ENT_CODE ) AS BANK_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER_BANK bnk WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = #{customerCode} AND SOLUTION = 'ECM'

/* SmsCousMapper.selectEcmCustomerInterface : ECM Customer Interface Detail */ SELECT SOLUTION ,IF_SERVICE_CODE ,IF_RECEIVER_ID ,IF_LOGIN_ID ,IF_LOGIN_PW ,IF_ETC_1 ,IF_ETC_2 ,IF_ETC_3 ,IF_ETC_4 ,IF_ETC_5 ,IF_ETC_6 FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER_INTERFACE WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = #{customerCode} ORDER BY SOLUTION, IF_SERVICE_CODE

/* smsCous.selectCustomerInterface : 하위업체 크림 API 키 조회 */ SELECT SOLUTION ,IF_SERVICE_CODE ,IF_RECEIVER_ID ,IF_LOGIN_ID ,IF_LOGIN_PW ,IF_ETC_1 ,IF_ETC_2 ,IF_ETC_3 ,IF_ETC_4 ,IF_ETC_5 ,IF_ETC_6 FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER_INTERFACE WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = #{customerCode} AND IF_SERVICE_CODE = #{ifServiceCode}

/* SmsCousMapper.selectEcmUserList : Ecm User List */ SELECT usr.USE_YN ,usr.USER_TYPE ,usr.USER_ID ,usr.USER_EMAIL ,usr.USER_LOGIN_ID ,usr.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,usr.USER_NAME ,usr.CUSTOMER_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = usr.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,usr.REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime FROM TB_SMS_USER usr LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_USER_OPTION opt ON usr.ENT_CODE = opt.ENT_CODE AND usr.USER_ID = opt.USER_ID WHERE usr.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND opt.USER_CLASS = 'ECM-USER'
AND usr.CUSTOMER_CODE = #{srchCustomerCode}
